name: Halverson Draftweave Slim Dress Trouser
description: Charcoal-brown slacks in Halverson's proprietary Draftweave — a temperature-buffering fabric that stays cool in overheated offices and blocks chill during Lake Michigan wind exposure. Cut slim through the thigh with a discreet side zipper for prosthetic leg access. Small Scandinavian-West African print detail runs along the interior waistband: visible only when you choose to show it.
functionality: Passive temperature buffering, prosthetic-access side zip, reinforced knee panels.
what_it_says: You understand that quality is invisible to most people, and that's exactly why you bought it.
story_hooks: The thermal buffering was originally designed for cold-storage facility workers; someone at Halverson realized it worked perfectly for executives who commute through the outdoor walkways.
A single lot of these came out with the Draftweave woven backwards — they look identical but the thermal properties are reversed, making them unbearably hot indoors.

physical_description.visual_profile: Tailored business-formal silhouette with a distinctly modern edge—sleek and understated at first glance, revealing subtle cultural markers only to the wearer. Sits at the hip with a refined break at the ankle, projecting quiet corporate competence.
physical_description.fit: Slim through hip and thigh with a gentle taper to the ankle. Cut to accommodate cybernetic augmentation without excess fabric. Waistband sits neutral and comfortable; the proprietary stretch weave prevents bunching around prosthetic interfaces.
physical_description.primary_material: Halverson Draftweave—a bio-engineered synthetic blend (polyamide/algae-cellulose core with phase-change polymer microcapsules). Matte finish with imperceptible sheen under direct light.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost liquid-like surface. Close inspection reveals fine ribbed structure that dissipates heat. Fabric drapes cleanly and has a subtle weight that signals quality without ostentation.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal-brown base (Pantone 19-1318—a versatile neutral that reads as both professional and street-smart). Interior waistband features a narrow Scandinavian-West African geometric jacquard in cream, ochre, and deep indigo—visible only when waistband is exposed or folded.
physical_description.closures: Center fly with discrete magnetic snap (Halverson signature). Right-side concealed zipper (8 cm) positioned for easy prosthetic limb donning/removal—integrated into the seam so it's invisible when closed. Standard belt loops.
distinctive_features: Proprietary Draftweave fabric with temperature-regulating phase-change microcapsules
Concealed side-zip prosthetic access panel—seamlessly integrated, zero visual indicator when fastened
Hidden cultural waistband print—visible only to the wearer or intimate observers
Reinforced interior thigh and crotch seams for durability and prosthetic friction points
Magnetic snap closure reduces snagging with augmentation contact points
Halverson & Mäki subtle woven label at interior waistband
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2–3 boundary. Affordable luxury positioning—expensive enough to signal stable employment and access to corpo amenities, yet accessible to upwardly mobile working class.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by mixed-heritage GLMZ professionals—corpo office workers, mid-level administrators, medical/tech sector employees who navigate both climate-controlled towers and street-level urban exposure. The hidden cultural print signals diaspora pride worn close to the body; a private affirmation of identity in homogenized corporate spaces.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly broken-in. Draftweave resists wrinkles and pilling; even after months of wear, these retain a fresh, 'just-tailored' appearance unless actively abused. Minor creasing at the knee and a soft shine at the inner thigh from prosthetic contact is normal and expected.
